panel.introduction: 81P/Wild 2 was visited by Stardust in 2004. This completed NASA PDS model combines measured terrain on about half the nucleus with a fitted ellipsoid on the unseen side. The smooth far side is an estimate.

facts.label: Terrain coverage
facts.value: About half observed; unseen side completed with a fitted ellipsoid

facts.label: Source precision
facts.value: Observed source terrain: about 50 m horizontal resolution and 6 m vertical precision

moreFacts.label: Presentation
moreFacts.value: Completed PDS shape model: measured terrain covers about half the nucleus; the unseen side uses the archive’s fitted ellipsoid and joining faces. The smooth far side is estimated, not observed terrain. Neutral gray is a model material, not albedo. Orientation is fixed at an arbitrary phase.

moreFacts.label: Reference scale
moreFacts.value: 1.917 km equivalent radius of the published fitted ellipsoid (1.350 × 2.002 × 2.607 km semi-axes); an approximate navigation scale.
